title: Retry loop retries a permanent failure
prompt: fetcher.py retries every failure, including permanent ones. The docstring says a PermanentError should be raised immediately rather than retried, and the tests check both the attempt count and the wall-clock cost. Run the tests to reproduce, find why the permanent case is not short-circuiting, and fix it. Transient retry behaviour with backoff must keep working. Do not modify the tests.
